ex.en: What is the most convenient route to your place?
ex.zh: 到您那裡哪條路線最方便？

ex.en: Whichever route you take, you will get there in time.
ex.zh: 不管你選哪條路，你都能按時到那裡。

ex.en: Luckily, we found an escape route.
ex.zh: 幸好我們找到了一條逃生路線。

ex.en: We ordered room service because we were too tired to go out.
ex.zh: 我們太累了不想出門，所以叫了客房服務。

ex.en: Room service is available 24 hours a day.
ex.zh: 客房服務 24 小時提供。

ex.en: Please give me a round-trip ticket to Chicago.
ex.zh: 請給我一張到芝加哥的來回票。

ex.en: Did you buy a round-trip ticket?
Take the second exit at the roundabout.
There's a roundabout just after the bridge.
ex.zh: 過橋後馬上有一個圓環。

ex.en: He asked in a roundabout way whether I was single.
ex.zh: 他拐彎抹角地問我是不是單身。

ex.en: Don't be so roundabout. Just tell me.
ex.zh: 別拐彎抹角了，直接告訴我吧。
